sources: Pew Research Center (2007), Modern Marriage – share of US adults rating items 'very important' for a successful marriage: faithfulness 93%, happy sexual relationship 70%, sharing household chores 62%.

Carlson (2022), Sex Roles (Council on Contemporary Families brief) – nationally representative US surveys; among couples who equally shared all tasks, 99% said the division was fair; among couples with a 50/50 split but no shared tasks, only about half did; the number of equally shared tasks mattered for both men's and women's relationship quality.
Carlson et al. (2018), Council on Contemporary Families brief – of all chores, sharing the dishes was most closely tied to women's relationship satisfaction.
